## 3. DESCRIPTION (Final Public Copy — Plain Text)
The city is quiet before the day begins.
Soft pre-dawn light spreads across a retro desk as a CRT monitor glows steadily in the early hours.
This 3-hour LoFi and Synthwave mix is designed for calm focus, early-morning coding, studying, writing, or uninterrupted creative work. The sound evolves slowly from night stillness into gentle morning clarity, maintaining a stable, distraction-free atmosphere throughout.
Warm analog textures, restrained rhythms, and steady harmonic movement support long focus sessions without sudden changes or fatigue.
All music is royalty free and safe for content creators.
